notablePrerequisites:
Hidetsugu does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{B}{R}.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {C}{C}.
Golgari Thug dies, putting itself on top of your library from your graveyard .
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{B}{R}.
Activate Hidetsugu's second ability by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, exiling Golgari Thug from the top of your library with the ability to cast it from exile this turn, and dealing 2 damage to any target.
Cast Golgari Thug from exile by paying {1}{B}.
Golgari Thug enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
